children.content: The default trigger mode is hover, you can change it to click.

children.name: A button is on the left, and a related f
children.content: A button is on the left, and a related functional menu is on the right. You can set the icon property to modify the icon of right.

children.name: The default trigger mode is hover, you c
children.content: The default trigger mode is hover, you can change it to contextMenu. The pop-up menu position will follow the right-click position.

children.name: Configure the selectable property in men
children.content: Configure the selectable property in menu to enable selectable ability.

children.name: You can customize the semantic dom style
children.content: You can customize the semantic dom style of the Dropdown by passing objects/functions through classNames and styles.

children.name: By specifying arrow prop with { pointAtC
children.content: By specifying arrow prop with { pointAtCenter: true }, the arrow will point to the center of the target element.

children.name: An event will be triggered when you clic
children.content: An event will be triggered when you click menu items, in which you can make different operations according to item's key.

children.name: Customize the dropdown menu via popupRen
children.content: Customize the dropdown menu via popupRender. If you don't need the Menu content, use the Popover component directly.

children.name: The default is to close the menu when yo
children.content: The default is to close the menu when you click on menu items, this feature can be turned off.

children.name: A loading indicator can be added to a bu
children.content: A loading indicator can be added to a button by setting the loading property.

children.name: Select any text in this paragraph to ope

children.content: Select any text in this paragraph to open a Dropdown menu near the selection. This is useful for actions such as masking sensitive words, marking entities, or searching the selected keyword. Example data: Alice, phone 13800138000, ID 110101199001011234.

children.name: Use Dropdown with the browser Selection
children.content: Use Dropdown with the browser Selection API to show custom actions after selecting text.
